name: Retry-aware clustering with an amortized energy-yield gate
status: Prospective extension protocol fixed before development and test outcomes; informed by previous exploratory experiments
development_selection: Choose horizon and optimized periodic comparator jointly by mean delivered samples at 40 J on the six nominal development scenarios. Gate uses the selected horizon. Deterministic ties prefer lower horizon then lower period.
gate: At five-round polls, charge 100-bit residual-energy telemetry to BS for every alive sensor; choose reform if candidate H-horizon predicted yield after reconfiguration exceeds retained clustering yield by 2 percent. No instantaneous channel states or future random numbers are used.
clustering: Deterministic two-pass single-head swap search maximizing predicted delivered samples per joule including retry expectations, node energy exhaustion approximation and reconfiguration cost. Same nearest-head membership rule and head count as original heuristic. No MILP or global optimality claim.
primary: Delivered source samples under 40 J, OptimizedGate minus each of Never, Period5, OptimizedPeriod, BaseGate, NoRetryGate, NoSurvivalGate, averaged equally across four conditions with scenario-cluster bootstrap and paired t test on 20 four-condition scenario means; Holm family of six two-sided contrasts
secondary: All 10/20/30 J and condition-specific contrasts are descriptive intervals, no confirmatory claims; service by round 200 only if reached; control telemetry/reform bits, requests, changed heads, runtime, censored endpoints retained.
interpretation: Benefits are conditional on stated simulation. Negative/null outcomes retained. No new DQN training and no claims of superiority over faithfully reproduced published LEACH-RLC. Attachment results are prior work, never pooled with these experiments.
